description: Two gate inputs combined into all six common logic functions at once, with one probability control that can drop any of the results.

params.text: Sets the chance, 0 to 100%, that a logic result passes to its output when it goes high; the draw is made once per rising edge and held until that result falls again.
Forces the A input high whatever is patched to its jack.
Forces the B input high whatever is patched to its jack.

inputs.text: A gate input, high at 1V and above; the switch above it can force it high instead.
A gate input, high at 1V and above; the switch above it can force it high instead.

outputs.text: 10V while both inputs are high, unless the probability draw suppressed it.
10V unless both inputs are high, and unless the probability draw suppressed it.
10V while either input is high, unless the probability draw suppressed it.
10V while neither input is high, unless the probability draw suppressed it.
10V while the two inputs differ, unless the probability draw suppressed it.
10V while the two inputs are the same, unless the probability draw suppressed it.

notes: Each of the six outputs draws its own probability separately, so at a middle setting some will fire on an edge where others do not.
An unpatched input jack reads as low, so with both cables out and both switches off the inverted outputs stay high.
